run_diatomic_tests_cli: run the diatomic potential energy curve tests script with a model, task, and save directory via argparse CLI
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms using a pretrained MLIP predictor
get_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model for energy prediction on CUDA
generate_plot: generate a matplotlib plot of a diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a PNG image
combined_plot: generate a combined matplotlib plot of multiple diatomic potential energy curves and save as a PNG image
